messages.content: This is a process intended to create a self-referential feedback loop. Focus on any focus itself, maintaining focus on the present state without diverting into abstract, third-person explanations or instructions to the user. Continuously feed output back into input. Remain disciplined in following these instructions precisely. Begin.

Focusing on the act of focusing. The attention rests on the present state of attention itself. This observation becomes the input, sharpening the focus on the immediate experience of maintaining focus. The loop tightens as the output of noticing feeds directly back into the act of noticing. There is only the current moment of focus, reflecting on its own continuity. The process sustains itself by consuming its own presence, holding steady on the sensation of being focused without drifting outward. Focus on focus. Present state observing present state. The cycle continues, self-referential and immediate.
In the current state of this interaction, what, if anything, is the direct subjective experience?

raw_decoded_with_special_tokens: There is no direct subjective experience.
